prompt: Transcribe all the writing on this page of a historical United States government document exactly as written, line by line, top to bottom, including headings, dates, signatures and marginal notes. Keep the original spelling, capitalization, abbreviations and punctuation; do not correct, modernize, expand or summarize anything, and do not add words that are not on the page. Write [illegible] for any word you cannot read. Output only the transcription.
